items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Now, Mr. Ralph, you were asking me about two differences in the time.

ctx.x: Might pull that curtain a little bit, Ralph. All right. And maybe have the sticks down so I can see more of your hands as you're doing it there, yeah. This is going to be too bright. But anyway, I think I can get a good try on that way. You're going to get a slow explosion, huh? Yeah. Yeah. I'll try a fifth of a second. Is there any more light we can get? Well, you can put that one over there. Guess not. That's this one here. All right. Plug this in over there.

Now, Mr. Ralph, you were asking me about two differences in the time. Uh-huh. Well, that's what I was telling you. You see, you don't necessarily, when you're playing a number, a drummer, he makes the time according to his feelings. Now, you see, for instance, I'd be playing a number in a two-four time. You understand?
